invariants: Only n8n/ACP/TESSA may coordinate consequential writes across more than one system.
Provider-native automation may emit events or perform narrowly local operations but may not establish a competing cross-system orchestration plane.
Every domain has exactly one canonical authority; all other systems receive projections, derived records, or channel-specific representations.
Cross-system mutations require validation, normalization, authorization, idempotency, bounded retries, evidence/receipt generation, and reconciliation.
Mem stores durable semantic knowledge only, never runtime locks, leases, retries, pending transactions, idempotency state, transactional authorization, secrets, or provider tokens.
Paid acquisition remains blocked until advertiser verification, measurement provisioning, a real bounded conversion, and Pixel+CAPI deduplication are evidenced.

cross_system_execution.rule: Only n8n/ACP/TESSA may coordinate multi-system writes.

revenue_crm.rule: HubSpot owns contacts, companies, deals, lifecycle, revenue, and sales activity.

relationship_intelligence.rule: Folk owns founder network, partners, warm relationships, and strategic context; it is not the revenue CRM.

lead_enrichment.rule: Hunter discovers, verifies, and enriches; it never owns lifecycle or pipeline state.

scheduling.rule: Calendly owns availability and booking state; HubSpot receives sales/customer activity projections.

durable_knowledge.rule: Mem owns architecture decisions, verified procedures, summaries, research, postmortems, and durable context only.

technical_documentation_truth.rule: Documentation retrieval informs implementation but is not a runtime product authority.

commerce.rule: Shopify becomes canonical for product, variant, SKU, price, cart, checkout, order, and merchant-facing commerce state only when commerce is explicitly promoted to release scope.

fulfillment.rule: Printify owns manufacturing, provider, production, and fulfillment facts; it does not own the merchant catalog.

marketplace_channel.rule: Etsy listings and receipts are channel projections normalized into canonical commerce/revenue events.

corporate_product_marketing_web.rule: Wix owns corporate/product marketing pages, landing pages, service pages, and conversion-oriented site experiences when promoted from draft.

editorial_blog_publishing.rule: WordPress owns editorial/blog publishing and long-form research-derived articles.

customer_conversation_runtime.rule: Botpress may collect intent and present responses; consequential external actions must route through ACP authorization.

advertising_measurement.rule: Pixel and CAPI measure confirmed success boundaries; paid acquisition remains gated on verification and deduplication proof.

typography_discovery.rule: Typeface research is advisory; approved typography decisions must be persisted as brand artifacts.

audio_derivatives.rule: Speechify creates downstream narration/accessibility derivatives and never owns source content.

wix_vs_wordpress.wix: Corporate/product marketing, landing pages, service pages, conversion-oriented web experiences.
wix_vs_wordpress.wordpress: Editorial/blog publishing and long-form research-derived articles.
wix_vs_wordpress.prohibited_overlap: The same canonical page/article must not be independently authored in both systems; cross-publishing must originate from one canonical content object and be treated as an explicit projection.

boundaries.botpress: Botpress may read approved context and collect structured intent but may not independently mutate HubSpot, Shopify, Calendly, email, billing, fulfillment, or other consequential systems.

the_verdict_paid_acquisition_gate: Same Pixel ID bound to browser Pixel and server CAPI.
One deterministic event_id generated per logical conversion and reused by Pixel and CAPI.
Recent conversion events inspected and duplicate transports proven to deduplicate into one logical conversion.
Evidence preserved in ADS-001 or successor receipt.
Paid acquisition activation permitted only after all previous gates pass.
change_control: Any authority change requires a new versioned governance decision. Connector convenience is never sufficient reason to silently change domain ownership.
